purpose: Preserve environmental-exposure provenance during R2 HOME/TRAVEL and A-B-A transfer experiments so shipping/handling state changes are not silently attributed to facility effects.

planning_assumptions.rationale: A 15-minute maximum gap is a provisional data-completeness screen only; it is not a device-safety or shipping qualification limit and must be retired or justified from the selected logger/process before physical qualification.

optional_engineering_limits.rule: Null limits mean UNKNOWN, never zero. Exposure acceptability cannot be PASS/FAIL until a limit has documented provenance.

classification.LOG_COMPLETE: All required provenance/channels exist, timestamps are monotonic, endpoints bracket the declared transfer window, and no sample gap exceeds the frozen completeness gap.
classification.INCOMPLETE: Required provenance/channels are missing or the record has a timing gap/provenance defect.
classification.WITHIN_DECLARED_LIMITS: All supplied non-null engineering limits pass after conservative measurement-uncertainty expansion.
classification.EXCEEDS_DECLARED_LIMIT: At least one supplied non-null engineering limit fails after conservative measurement-uncertainty expansion.
classification.LIMITS_UNKNOWN: One or more relevant engineering limits are null; no safety/material-compatibility pass is claimed.

claim_boundary: A complete or within-limit exposure log does not establish device stability, facility equivalence, shipping qualification, electrical stability, or any quantum mechanism.
